Cauchy shadow formula yields exactly seven centered generators; all 35 determinant triples are explicitly partitioned. The exact volume follows by octahedron/cube clipping. Two exact rational derivatives factor through quintic/quartic polynomials with exactly one positive root after Descartes substitutions; endpoint signs and Bernstein-positive certificate establish global extrema and exactly two crossings of 8. Reproduced using symbolic identities and independent numerical convex-hull volumes at five rational parameters. The claim is limited to the stated closed family.

value.rationale: The affine ratio \(P(K)=\operatorname{vol}(\Pi K)/\operatorname{vol}(K)^2\) is a central natural invariant in Brannen/Saroglou/Petty projection-body geometry. The cube-to-octahedron interpolation is a standard geometric family containing Platonic, Archimedean and zonohedral reference shapes. Its exact full invariant exhibits two nontrivial internal critical points and two 8-crossings, with a nonregular global minimizer displaced from the known regular truncated octahedron and a whole non-zonotope sub-eight interval. This is a complete natural classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice, known-table recomputation or routine small numerical improvement.
